svg.aria-label: Context residency. Budgeting is a measurement, and so is uptake.
svg.text: Budgeting is a measurement, and so is uptake.
Also resident: step plan and lessons
Paged in on demand, except the kernel
Emitted at dispatch, before the call
In the index and never cited; it may still have loaded
A citation proves injection, not influence.
Skill files are cited, not inlined: an agent the orchestrator dispatches carries
the kernel and a one-line index, and fetches a numbered or named section when a
step needs it. A producer is handed its playbook instead, which carries its
citations but not the kernel. Receipts record what was given at dispatch against
what the agent cited, and the receipt contract states what that cannot show: a
recorded reduction (f0e35c1) and today's loads, estimate mode
